summary_en: G-7 Holdings authorized repurchase of up to 1.5 million shares (3.4% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥3 billion through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 2, 2026 and November 1, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, G-7 Holdings' Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of its own shares based on Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied by reading into Article 165(3). The company resolved to repurchase up to 1.5 million shares, representing 3.4% of outstanding shares (calculated as 1,500,000 ÷ 43,771,028 × 100), for a maximum aggregate amount of ¥3 billion. The repurchases will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 2, 2026 through November 1, 2027.

The buyback authorization is intended to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the operating environment. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 300,426 treasury shares, with 43,771,028 shares outstanding excluding those in treasury.
